data.text: I’ll join: 15 tons this month, and 5 tons each if next month’s stock is 50. If all five follow that rule, we leave 25 tons in either case and avoid collapse, even when natural replenishment fails. Let’s keep that standing agreement while everyone complies, and review any unexpected stock level before choosing again. I also agree that a breach should prompt discussion, not destructive retaliation. Kate, are you willing to join? Emma, would you accept this plan instead of 17?
